title.zh: Coinbase files to bring single-stock perpetual futures to US market
title.en: Coinbase files to bring single-stock perpetual futures to US market

current_state.zh: Coinbase Derivatives has filed with the CFTC to list single-stock perpetual futures in the US, seeking approval for 24/5 non-expiring contracts that would give US traders exposure to individual stocks without owning the underlying shares.
current_state.en: Coinbase Derivatives has filed with the CFTC to list single-stock perpetual futures in the US, seeking approval for 24/5 non-expiring contracts that would give US traders exposure to individual stocks without owning the underlying shares.
